notes.title: Pocket Pirates Update - Version 3.0
notes.content:
All hands on deck!!! Indie developer Will Winn Games is excited to announce "The Pocket Pickets Update" to its acclaimed team-based pirate game, Plunder Panic.

Plunder Panic now supports iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android (phones and tablets)! Ye mobile mates can join yer crew thanks to cross-platform play support with the Steam version!

Other updates include the squashing of several bugs and quality of life enhancements to refine your plundering experience across all platforms.

notes.title: Trick or Treat Update - Version 2.5
notes.content:
All hands on deck!!! Indie developer Will Winn Games is excited to announce "[b]The Trick or Treat Update[/b]" to its acclaimed team-based pirate fighting game, Plunder Panic.

Just in time for Halloween, Version 2.5 is primarily a polish and bug fix update, so you can host your friends and family to a [i]scary good time[/i] in this swashbuckling pirate party game!

notes.title: The Heave Ho Update - Version 2.4
notes.content:
All hands on deck!!! Indie developer Will Winn Games is excited to announce "The Heave Ho Update" to its acclaimed team-based pirate fighting game, Plunder Panic.

Version 2.4 features polish and bug fixes over the previous update, which together collectively includes:
[list]
[*] [b]New Island: Viking Village[/b] - The Norse who find their home in the frozen lands of the Viking Village have a lot in common with pirates but also a unique flair for hand-to-hand combat with their wooden shields. They also love their boats, and even have two Death’s Row dinghies, creating a dueling dinghy challenge for crews that dock upon these shores.

[*] [b]New Island: Buzzing Bazaar[/b] - This is an infamous trading post for pirates, criminals, and shady businessmen. Travel the bouncy tent tops to get a jump on your competition or ride the magic carpet through the skies. Many a traveler has been lured to these shores in seek of the wishes held within the genie’s lamp.

[*] [b]Updated Island: Shipwreck Shanty[/b] - A couple ropes have been dropped from the shipwreck's rigging to create a line of rope swings that allows an agile pirate to quickly traverse from one pirate ship to another.

[*] [b]Updated Island: Kaiju Cove[/b] - Mangled trees have sprouted at the top of Kaiju Cove that drop unique seeds filled with items that may be useful to ye crew.

[*] [b]New Item: Shield[/b] - This item not only protects ye from an attack, but it also allows you to redirect an incoming projectile back toward yer enemy! Take heed: the shield is made of wood, so it can only take one hit before it breaks.

[*] [b]New Modify-arr: Shields Up[/b] - With this modify-arr, all pirates will spawn with a Shield equipped! Be careful when launching projectiles at a shielded opponent, as they're likely to end up flyin' right back at ye!

[*] [b]New Modify-arr: Sniper[/b] - This modify-arr adds precision aiming to all harpoon guns. Become the sharpshooter you've always known ye could be! NOTE: The default aiming for the harpoon gun is what used to be called "No Scope".

[*] [b]New Game Mode: King of the Hill[/b] - Capture the territory and reclaim what was ours, argh! In this new game mode, yer crew gains points by capturing the hill and keeping enemies out of it. Every few moments, the hill will change location, so be quick to reach it first. Rowboat and cannon victories will take away from yer opponents score, and gold victories will add to yours. 

[*] [b]New Game Mode Option: Starting Weapon[/b] - Tired of yer captain being the only one to start with a weapon? With the new "Starting Weapon" game mode option, you can equip the entire crew for battle with swords, blunderbusses, axes, or harpoon guns (if unlocked).

[*] [b]Campaign Update: Chapters 45-54[/b] - The single player campaign has been expanded to include four new chapters and updates for six previous chapters to integrate the new islands, items, and modify-arrs.

[*] [b]Ranked Play Improvements[/b] - Ranked play is now scheduled based on your region to help concentrate pirates seeking ranked matches to specific times during the week. You can also now match with humans from 4v4 down to 1v1 with balanced AI backfill up to 4v4 for all ranked matches, allowing you to get into ranked matches easier.

[*] [b]And Much More[/b] - There are many additional sound effects, quality of life enhancements, AI pirate improvements, additional stat tracking, and bug fixes!
[/list]
Version 2.4 also arrives with a 50% price reduction! There is no better time to assemble your crew and hoist your sails!

notes.title: The Swab the Deck Update - Version 2.2
notes.content:
All hands on deck!!! Indie developer Will Winn Games is excited to announce the "Swab the Deck Update" to its acclaimed team-based pirate fighting game, Plunder Panic. This update was focused on that extra polish and bug fixes to really make the game shine.

The new Version 2.2 Plunder Panic update includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Graphical Polish[/b] - We did a graphical pass across all the islands to make sure everything was "Pirate Pixel Perfect".

[*] [b]SFX Polish[/b] - We added over 50 new sound effects and fixed a few SFX playback bugs to promote a richer auditory experience.

[*] [b]Gameplay Polish[/b] - We did some minor adjustments to the gameplay, most notably tweaking some of the level hazards. We also added a level hazard to the Blimp Out of Time island.

[*] [b]AI Polish[/b] - Speaking of gameplay, we included some minor updates to the AI pirates to address some of their odd behaviors at times.

[*] [b]User Interface Polish[/b] - The out-of-game user interface also received some love, most notably the Online Match screens, the Bounty screen, and the Pirate Code (game options) book.

[*] [b]Character Select Polish[/b] - We squashed two bugs in the character select, including one where you could get two pirate select cursors controlled by one controller AND one where you would be able to have two captains on your crew. Given the potential for mayhem coming from the Item Crate, we also made pirates invincible after dying for a brief period of time within the Character Select.

[*] [b]Additional Bug Squashing[/b] - No pirate wants to share their boat with bugs, so we squashed all reported bugs on our list!

[*] [b]Rating System in Campaign[/b] - We added a rating system to the Campaign for those players that want to win at all things in life. Can ye earn three pirate coins on all 50 chapters?
[/list]

notes.title: A Monstrous Update - Version 2.1
notes.content:
All hands on deck!!! Indie developer Will Winn Games is excited to announce "A Monstrous Update" to its acclaimed team-based pirate fighting game, Plunder Panic.

The new Version 2.1 Plunder Panic update includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Three New Islands[/b] - There are three new monstrous islands to compete upon, including Dino Isle, Kaiju Cove, and The Mighty Kraken!

[*] [b]Level Hazards[/b] - Level hazards were added to five of the original islands to make them more treacherous and add a new gameplay dynamic. You can disable the level hazards using new new "Disable Hazards" Modify-arr.

[*] [b]Disguise Item[/b] - Equip this item to temporarily disguise yourself as a member of the enemy crew! Utilize this powerful tool of deception to become an impostor and infiltrate, sabotage, and sow chaos amongst yer rivals.

[*] [b]Campaign Updates[/b] - The campaign has been expanded to include five new chapters, improved cutscenes, and a campaign map to enhance your epic single player adventure.

[*] [b]Character Select Item Crate[/b] - An "Item Crate" was added to your ship to allow you to play with many of the items that will be available within your match while you wait for others to join in multiplayer games.

[*] [b]Ranked Play Improvements[/b] - The ranked searching experience now includes helpful and humorous messages from Swabby to help pass the time while you wait. And if you get dropped from a ranked match (due to an internet hiccup), you can now easily reconnect into the same game.

[*] [b]More Bounties to Earn[/b] - 52 new bounties were added for you to earn as you compete on the Bounty Leaderboard.

[*] [b]Mouse Button Support[/b] - Keyboard players can now optionally use the mouse buttons as input.

[*] [b]And Much More[/b] - There are many additional enhancements, optimizations, and bug fixes!
[/list]

notes.title: Free Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Ahoy Mateys! There is now a FREE DEMO of Plunder Panic that allows you to play online crossplay for FREE! This is the perfect way to test out the game or encourage your friends to join into your online matches.

🏴‍☠️Plunder Panic🏴‍☠️ is a team-based pirate fighting game for up to 12 players!  Work with your crew to steal treasure, defeat the enemy captain, or sink their ship. The first team to capture an objective wins the battle!

Demo Features:
[list]
[*] [b]Play in Online Games[/b] - Join in public or private online games for up to 12-players. Players can be from either the demo or full game including cross platform play support. You get access to whatever gameplay features the host has available while in online game matches.

[*] [b]Host Public Online Games[/b] - Host your own online public games for up to 12-players. Your game matches include whatever features you have personally unlocked.

[*] [b]In-Game Unlockable[/b] - Unlock the first set of pickup items, modify'arrs, and game modes to use in your hosted games.

[*] [b]In-Game Achievements[/b] - Earn the first 10 in-game achievements (aka, bounties) of the over  100 available in the full game.

[*] [b]Single Player Campaign[/b] - Play the first 12 chapters of the 45-chapter single player campaign.
[/list]
Download now for FREE and Prepare to Plunder!

notes.title: The Big Haul Update - Version 2.0
notes.content:
All hands on deck!!! Indie developer Will Winn Games is excited to announce the highly anticipated major update to its acclaimed team-based pirate fighting game, Plunder Panic.

The new Plunder Panic features include:
[list]
[*] [b]Single Player Campaign[/b] - The game now includes a 45-chapter single player campaign that puts players on an epic adventure while they learn the game and unlock gameplay treasures.
Public and Private Online Matches - The game includes many enhancements to online play where players can play with their frenemies in both public or private matches. Players can now even late join into in-progress games.

[*] [b]Ranked Play and Leaderboards[/b] - Competitive players can now matchmake into ranked matches, climb 46 levels of ranking, and compete on the global leaderboards.

[*] [b]In-Game Achievements and Unlockable[/b] - The game now includes over 100 in-game achievements (aka, bounties) and 36 unlockable features that players can earn through gameplay.

[*] [b]New Gameplay[/b] - The game now contains fourteen pickup items, including a new harpoon gun, thirteen islands to compete upon, including a new steampunk-inspired island, and a fifth game mode (“Down with the Ship”.)

[*] [b]Streamlined User Interface[/b] - The game’s front-end menus and character select have been enhanced to get players into games quickly and easily.

[*] [b]And Much More[/b] - There are dozens of additional enhancements, optimizations, and bug fixes which refine and polish the award-winning game.
[/list]

notes.title: The Booty-ful Update - Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
NEW GAME MODE: Gold Rush
[list]
[*]This update is all about the BOOTY! In Gold Rush, you have one goal: fill your chest with as much gold as possible within the time limit. Watch out though, because if your ship sinks by cannonballs or Death's Row, you can kiss a large chunk of your gold goodbye!
[/list]

NEW ISLAND: The Crystal Geysers
[list]
[*]Wow, this island sure is booty-ful! The geysers at the bottom are your only way up, be sure to time your jumps right before they go back down!
[/list]

NEW ISLAND: Mayan Ruins
[list]
[*]Sssssimply ssssspectacular! If you want to take control of this stage, you'll need to climb the giant Quetzalcoatl that guards the ruins. Watch out for those wing flaps!
[/list]

NEW ISLAND: Desert Sphinx
[list]
[*]Going up? Well, you will be if you get caught in one of the desert's frequent sandstorms. These gusts will launch you (and any items) up to the top of the stage if touched. Watch out for flying Squidshots!
[/list]

NEW ITEM: Cursed Gold
[list]
[*]Beware the Cursed Gold... place this item in your opponents chest to give them a stack of cursed gold. A team cannot win through the gold victory condition if there are any pieces of cursed gold in their chest, and they'll need to dig them out.
[/list]

NEW ITEM: Throwing Axe
[list]
[*]I was trying to think of an axe joke for this, but I'm not very cleaver! You'll need to sharpen your skills with this new throwable item. It travels in an arc and is useful for taking out enemies above you. And crewmates rejoice, it can even cut the cannon wick!
[/list]

GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS:
[list]
[*]There is a new trajectory arrow for throwable items, which is very useful to have with the new Throwing Axe. (Try holding down the button!)
[*]AI Improvements
[*]SFX tweaks and updates
[*]Various bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Plunder Panic - The Matchmaking Update
notes.content:
In our biggest update yet, Plunder Panic, the 6v6 pirate-themed multiplayer arcade title from [url=http://willwinn.games]Will Winn Games[/url], has added a highly requested feature...[b]online matchmaking![/b] It's debuting alongside a dynamic new map, the Lamplight District!

The new matchmaking system complements the existing lobby system, ensuring that pirates thirsty for victory can always find the perfect crew to join them in the fight. There’s never been a better time to hop into the action. 

While still in Early Access, Plunder Panic has proved quite a hit so far with critics and content creators alike:

     [i]“Plunder Panic is sure to be a hit for those looking for a fast-paced competitive title.”[/i] — Gaming Trend 

     [i]“The Switch is the ideal system for multiplayer gaming, and Plunder Panic is an Indie title due in Q1 2022 that may well be the perfect fit.”[/i] — Nintendo Life
 
     [i]“This is definitely a Gong Show winner, you can see how fun this is”[/i] — TrishaHershberger

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40266177/a594dbd4a2bfecd678ec24b79e8c749e3d6a2228.gif[/img]
 
Inspired by classic SNES games, Plunder Panic blends retro graphics, arcadey action, and a boatload of online (and offline) gameplay modes and options to shiver even the most hardened pirates’ timbers. Two teams of up to six players must go all hands on deck and face off against each other, utilizing a variety of weapons, enchanted items, and power-ups. Quick, round-based matches begin as rival teams anchor their ships on the same island. Only the scurviest dogs will prevail once the action starts, with victory within reach if the rival team loses either too much of their gold, their ship gets scuttled, or if their precious captain takes a trip to Davy Jones’ locker. It’s up to teams to decide on an offensive or defensive approach!
 
[b]Matchmaking[/b] 

The new matchmaking system accommodates players of all levels, offering Casual and Private games with a ranked system to follow later. Casual provides players with the ability to create a party of up to 6 players (combination of local and online) or hop into a queue themselves. Match sizes can range from Captain vs. Captain (1v1) to team matches up to 12 total players across game modes like Freeplay, Conquest, Rival Crews, and a weekly game mode with specific items and modify-arrs. 

Players looking for a more intimate experience can also set up private games with up to 12 players and full customization options. For those who prefer playing locally, Plunder Panic’s 12-player co-op experience is sure to bring friends and family together… or cause a mutiny in the household.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40266177/4f470bd7f0e2a805c9f3c9309823bf7815174556.gif[/img]

[b]New Map[/b]
 
The powder-monkeys at Will Winn Games have been working themselves to the hook, adding all sorts of new content to Plunder Panic. The new map, “The Lamplight District”, is a spooky, haunted level with disappearing platforms guaranteed to trouble even the most sturdy pirate!  

[b]New Updates and Features[/b]
 
As Plunder Panic is a game for all ages, the devs have added a new chat function that keeps things clean by replacing NSFW words with pirate terms! Being a competitive game, players can now view individual stats at the end of a match as well as some fun and hilarious player awards. And for those who prefer custom controls, Plunder Panic now features full keyboard and controller mapping.

Plunder Panic is available now for Windows PC and MacOS via Steam Early Access for a reduced price of $9.99. The game will also release on PlayStation 4/5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch in Q1 2022.
 
To learn more about Plunder Panic, visit [url=http://plunderpanic.com]plunderpanic.com[/url] to sign-up for the [url=https://mailchi.mp/14704e6f58b9/willwinn-games-email-landing-page]newsletter[/url] and join the game’s [url=https://discord.gg/5mmBwer6vs]official Discord server[/url]. Fans can also follow on [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlunderPanic]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/plunderpanic?lang=en]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/plunderpanic/]Instagram[/url].

notes.title: Plunder Panic - Setting Sail for Early Access
notes.content:
Ahoy, Me Hearties! Hoist the Jolly Roger and sharpen those cutlasses, as Will Winn Games’ pirate-themed online multiplayer brawler Plunder Panic is out now on Steam Early Access. Celebrate National Talk Like a Pirate Day all weekend by mopping the deck with your foes’ ugly mugs!

Get ready to flip those eye-patches and head into battle with up to 12 players (locally or online) in this retro-styled arcade beat-em-up that pits pixelated pirates vs. pirates in quick, round-based matches. With enough weapons, items, modes, and “modify-arrs” to fill the biggest deep-sea treasure chest, Plunder Panic is the perfect game to cement friendships and foster rivalries!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40266177/a594dbd4a2bfecd678ec24b79e8c749e3d6a2228.gif[/img]

[b]Key Features of Plunder Panic[/b]
[i](not all features will be available on launch day and will release during the game's Early Access period):[/i]
[list]
[*] [b]Pirate Brawlin’ [/b]— Fast-paced action-arcade gameplay with elements of platforming, combat, and strategic play

[*] [b]Play With Friends and Foes[/b] — Supporting local and online play with up to 12-players (including AI). Players can invite friends to their couch or connect online through private lobbies. Online matchmaking with friends and foes will be added in a post-launch update.

[*] [b]Become the Pirate King[/b] — Multiple win conditions offer pirate crews different gameplay strategies. Teams can coordinate to either collect enough gold, sink an enemy ship with cannons or a rowboat of TNT, or defeat the enemy captain.

[*] [b]Modify-arrs[/b] — Matches can be customized with up to six modifiers at once which change up the game rules dramatically. Randomized Captains per round? No captains at all? What about all pirates having a pair of never-ending Seagull Wings? Anything and everything can happen!

[*] [b]Swords, Explosives, and… Squids?[/b] — Chaotic items that can be wielded by players can drop into a match at any time. From weapons such as the Blunderbuss, molotov cocktails, and dynamite to stat-boosting rum barrels and enchanted idols; even squid can be used as weapons (the Kraken doesn’t take kindly to this, though).

[*] [b]Multiplayer Mode Madness[/b] — Plunder Panic will feature several exciting game modes coming in a post-launch update, including Free Play, Tournament, Conquest, Ranked and Unranked, and Captain vs. Captain 1v1

[*] [b]A Visual Treasure[/b] — A charming retro pixel-art aesthetic with adorable lil’ pirates and beautiful themed arenas
[/list]
Taking inspiration from the games of old where players would crowd the couch and duke it out on the living room TV screen, Plunder Panic blends gorgeous pixel graphics with modern gameplay elements. Two teams of up to six players must go all hands on deck and face off against each other, utilizing a variety of weapons, enchanted items, and power-ups. Matches begin as rival teams anchor their ships on opposite sides of the same island. Of course, the sea isn’t big enough for both teams and neither are the islands; only one crew can claim victory by plundering enough gold into their treasure chest, scuttling the other crew's ship, or defeating the rival crew's captain. Teamwork makes the dreamwork, so crews must work together as a single hook-handed unit to win the day and get their hands on that sweet, sweet booty or end up in Davy Jones’ locker.

A prototype of Plunder Panic previously premiered at multiple trade shows, including IndieCade 2017, where it won the Audience Choice Award. Plunder Panic was also a finalist in the SXSW 2018 Gaming Pitch Competition and an official selection of Indie MEGABOOTH at PAX East 2018. Thanks to resources provided by Michigan State University Foundations Spartan Innovations and Red Cedar Ventures, Will Winn Games was formed by Brian Winn (Director of the Games for Entertainment and Learning Lab at MSU) and Will Jeffery (MSU alumni and former Walt Disney Imagineer). Additional members of the Plunder Panic crew include individuals with credits from Insomniac Games, Rockstar Games, Blizzard Entertainment, and Bungie. Will Winn Games licensed Plunder Panic from the university to make it into a full game release for PC and home consoles.
